title: Sabrina Carpenter Brings Out Madonna at Coachella Weekend Two Headlining Set
summary: Geena Davis and Terry Crews also joined for surprise celebrity cameos during her Friday night show at the music festival.
contentText: "The thrilling thing I need to point out to everybody right now is this probably the first time I’ve ever performed with someone who’s shorter than me,” the Queen of Pop said of her performance with the "Manchild" singer.
